# Read-only emoji-in-heading findings (AI page tell) Next slice of LIM-e872b1 generic-template tells. Extends `limatus usability scan` only. No layout engine. ## DoD - Same CLI. New kind: `emoji_heading`. - Profile: `emoji.flagInHeadings` boolean, default **true**. Unknown keys rejected. Existing profiles still load. - When false, never emit this kind. - Flag `h1`–`h6` whose **direct plus descendant text** contains an emoji. Use the same Unicode ranges as editorial `_EMOJI_PATTERN` in `editorial_diagnosis.py` (`U+1F300–U+1FAFF`, `U+2600–U+27BF`, regional indicators). Prefer extracting that pattern to a tiny shared helper over duplicating the character class; do not refactor editorial finding logic. - Do **not** flag emoji in `p`, `li`, or other non-heading elements this slice. - JSON: `id`, `kind`, `selector`, `rationale`. Add `emoji_heading` to `SKILL.md` kinds list. - Tests (tempfile): `
